meta.description: ROLLER is the first manufacturer of PVC materials in Tajikistan. PVC windows and doors, aluminium and façade systems. Warmth and comfort for every home.

production.title: Our own plant, not <accent>resale</accent>
production.description: We extrude the profile ourselves: from extrusion to the finished unit, the survey and the installation. That is how we hold to schedule on developer volumes and answer for the result as a whole.

categories.title: Choose a category
categories.description: Windows, doors, sliding systems and façades. We will pick the profile that fits.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: PVC and aluminium window systems for flats, private houses and commercial buildings.
windows.heading: Plastic and aluminium windows in Dushanbe
windows.intro: We make windows at our own plant in Dushanbe: from the three-chamber economy series to the premium 75 mm profile. Survey, manufacturing, delivery and installation — by our own crews, with no middlemen.
windows.metaTitle: Plastic windows in Dushanbe — PVC and aluminium direct from the manufacturer
windows.metaDescription: Plastic and aluminium windows in Dushanbe from the manufacturer ROLLER: six profile systems, survey, manufacturing and installation. Price on calculation.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Entrance groups, balcony and interior doors in PVC and thermally broken aluminium.
doors.heading: PVC and aluminium doors in Dushanbe
doors.intro: We make door units to fit the opening: entrance doors in thermally broken aluminium for heated buildings, light aluminium doors for shops, and PVC balcony doors.
doors.metaTitle: Aluminium doors in Dushanbe — made-to-order PVC and aluminium doors
doors.metaDescription: Made-to-order aluminium and PVC doors in Dushanbe: entrance groups, balcony and interior doors from the manufacturer ROLLER. Survey and installation.

sliding-systems.title: Sliding systems
sliding-systems.description: Sliding windows and doors for balconies, terraces and panoramic openings.
sliding-systems.heading: Sliding windows and doors in Dushanbe
sliding-systems.intro: Sliding units save space where a casement has nowhere to swing: on a balcony, on a terrace, in a narrow passage. We build them on cold and thermally broken aluminium profile.
sliding-systems.metaTitle: Sliding windows and doors in Dushanbe
sliding-systems.metaDescription: Sliding aluminium systems for balconies, terraces and panoramic openings in Dushanbe. Made by ROLLER, survey and installation.

facade-glazing.title: Façade glazing
facade-glazing.description: Façade systems for residential complexes, business centres and retail buildings.
facade-glazing.heading: Façade glazing in Dushanbe
facade-glazing.intro: We work with developers on volume and schedule: glazing for residential complexes, curtain walls for business centres, entrance groups for retail buildings. Our own production keeps large batches on time.
facade-glazing.metaTitle: Façade glazing in Dushanbe — aluminium façade systems
facade-glazing.metaDescription: Façade glazing for residential complexes and business centres in Dushanbe: thermally broken and cold aluminium systems from the manufacturer ROLLER.

mosquito-nets.title: Insect screens
mosquito-nets.description: Screens for windows and doors — made to the size of the opening.
mosquito-nets.heading: Insect screens in Dushanbe
mosquito-nets.intro: Screens are made for a specific opening — framed for windows, hinged for doors. They have no catalogue of their own: the size is taken at the survey along with the window.
mosquito-nets.metaTitle: Insect screens in Dushanbe — for windows and doors
mosquito-nets.metaDescription: Insect screens for windows and doors in Dushanbe, made to the size of the opening. Made by ROLLER, survey and fitting.

partitions.title: Partitions
partitions.description: Office and retail partitions in cold aluminium with a slim profile.
partitions.heading: Aluminium partitions in Dushanbe
partitions.intro: Partitions divide an office, a shop or a showroom without eating the light. A slim 45 mm cold profile — where heating is not needed but geometry and strength are.
partitions.metaTitle: Aluminium partitions in Dushanbe — for offices and retail
partitions.metaDescription: Office and retail partitions in aluminium profile in Dushanbe. Made by ROLLER: survey, manufacturing and installation.
